name: Dezful

queries.query: Dezful Iran official cadastral map parcel GIS land registry public map API
queries.result: The official Dezful municipal portal was found and exposes a city-map tile, but its current HTML configuration has an empty link and no public parcel API. National registration/cadastre references identify the State Organization for Registration of Deeds and Properties, but no anonymous Dezful parcel endpoint or safe geometry response was verified.

queries.result: Search results identified the official Dezful municipal portal and national registration/cadastre terminology, but no official local Dezful cadastral viewer, public schema, anonymous parcel query, or safe parcel polygon was found. Commercial GIS listings and login-oriented surveying services were not treated as verified open registry sources.
